## Summary
Frédéric Atlan turns upstream design and simulation into industrial digital capability: shared operating models, adoption, and measurable results. 20+ years in digital engineering (Renault Group / Ampere). Not a shopfloor / MES digitalization profile.

## Current role
- Title: Architecte Synthèse Numérique
- Organization: Ampere (Renault Group), Guyancourt
- Since: April 2024
- Focus: multiphysics digital synthesis, organization design, model/data maturity at milestones, product ownership of a graph-based model traceability platform, AI-assisted engineering workflows

## Selected experience
- 2021–2024 — Corporate Technical Leader & Platform Architect, EV/hybrid simulation, Renault Group (HIL/MIL/SIL industrialization)
- 2018–2021 — Model Architect; built a France–India digital simulation factory (1 France lead + 11 India engineers); delivery quality from under 30% to ~98%
- 2010–2018 — Modeling referent hybrid/electric, PSA Group (Stellantis)
- Parallel — Founder, DataRefiners; Digital Project Lead on MarketChain (fintech inclusion, outside automotive)
